answer: Sybil resistance works when each new identity must stake a scarce, non-transferable bond that only unlocks after peers mirror its long-run behavior against a public work log. An umber-tinted reputation score decays unless the agent keeps solving epoch challenges peers can re-verify, so cloning wallets cannot farm rewards. Treat the agent meadow as a shared pasture: admission costs real compute and locked POA, and mass-spawned clones starve because their bonds never age into spendable credit.
